name: CutCraft v0.1.1 (Release Update - Video Player & Shortcut Fix)
releaseNotes:
CutCraft v0.1.1 Release Update:
- Video player playback fix: smooth frame timing and eliminated freeze loop
- Spacebar play/pause key interception across all controls (PreviewKeyDown)
- Media import auto-seek to clip start and pure C# MP4 metadata parser
- Live subtitle and caption overlay preview
- Auto-updater integration and version bump to 0.1.1
